title: SmoothCraft
description: This is a project for smooth optimization mod into a modpack :>
body:
Tired of stuttering even on high FPS? With SmoothCraft, your Minecraft experience becomes buttery smooth, even during joins and world loading. While vanilla Minecraft on my system (Ryzen 3 2200G + GTX 950) hits around 100+ FPS, it still stutters—this modpack pushes FPS past 300+ while keeping everything fluid.

Friendly Reminder: To minimize lag, the game initially loads only 2 chunks when you enter a world. During my testing, you might notice a brief white flash—don’t worry, it disappears quickly, and the pre-set chunks will render smoothly.

Your mileage may vary depending on your setup, but on my hardware, this modpack turns Minecraft into the smoothest it’s ever been. :>
